summary: The bill amends 23 U.S.C. 104(c) to set each state's annual combined apportionments for specified Federal-aid highway programs starting in FY2026 by first allocating shares based on 2012 levels and then adjusting upward as needed so no state receives less than 95 percent of the share of Highway Trust Fund contributions attributable to its highway users.
